defs.def: an event, a situation, or a period of time in sb's life, a novel, etc. that is important or interesting in some way （人生的）一段经历；（小说的）片段，插曲

ex.s: The strange earthquake – episodes that formed the main body of San Francisco gossip for the next week would fill a much larger book than this, and so I will now change the subject.
ex.t: 那场奇特的地震——构成旧金山接下来一周茶余饭后主要谈资的各个片段——足以写满一本比这厚得多的书，所以我现在要换个话题了。

ex.s: This was an episode in my life that I would never forget.
ex.t: 这是我一生中永远不会忘记的一段经历。

ex.s: If it hadn’t been for a three-episode documentary, outsiders would never have known that the plainly-dressed people working here are masters of their craft, who have spent their lives restoring precious antiques.
ex.t: 如果没有三集纪录片，外人永远不会知道在这里工作的穿着朴素的人是他们的手艺大师，他们一生都在修复珍贵的古董。

defs.def: one part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio in several parts （电视连续剧或广播剧的）一集

ex.s: Scott Fitzgerald’s most admired work will find themselves glued to their screens by episodes of The Great Gatsby.
ex.t: 菲茨杰拉德最受推崇的作品的爱好者，会被《了不起的盖茨比》的剧集牢牢吸引在屏幕前。

ex.s: Some men, dressed in black protective suits, take the meteor away … 2 Now listen to the start of the new episode and match the abilities to the character.
ex.t: 几个穿着黑色防护服的男人把陨石带走了…… 2 现在听新一集的开头，将能力和角色对应起来。
